# GNOME Shell 50 base stylesheet

Source: Fedora 44's GNOME Shell 50.5 theme resource.

Resource: `/org/gnome/shell/theme/gnome-shell-dark.css` from `gnome-shell-theme.gresource`.

Upstream: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gnome-shell

The stylesheet is kept unchanged. Its copyright notice and LGPL-2.1-or-later licence are retained.
